content.text: Omben (Javanese) or Minuman (Indonesian)â€”both meaning 'drink'â€”is a two-player Go Fish variant from Indonesia. Players ask for ranks; the opponent gives all cards of that rank or the asker 'drinks' by drawing until they find one. First to discard all cards wins.

Omben is the Indonesian/Javanese variant of the quartet-collection family that includes Go Fish and Authors. The name 'drink' may refer to the penalty of drawing when the opponent has no card of the requested rank.
Two players. Omben (Indonesian Go Fish) is played by exactly two players; each begins with 4 or 5 cards by agreement drawn from a 52-card pack, and the remainder forms the face-down stock.
Each player receives 4 or 5 cards (by agreement). Remaining cards form a face-down stock.
